purpose: Production failures that every later editorial engine must reject rather than imitate.

cases.text: Operating cash covers current capital spending at covered companies, but the 5.04-times commitment load pushes funding needs well beyond today's build.
cases.instruction: Split current funding capacity from future obligations. Name commitments directly and remove the undefined phrase today's build.

cases.text: AI investment is advancing faster than its conversion into capacity and broad economic gains.
failures: two downstream stages compressed into one comparison
cases.instruction: Name the physical and economic transitions separately.

cases.text: Internal cash funds current spending, not the full commitment pipeline.
cases.instruction: State what cash covers and what commitments require as a forward relationship.

cases.text: Those commitments expand supply options but do not yet represent delivered or operating compute capacity.
cases.instruction: Explain the work or transition between announced projects and usable supply.

cases.text: The registry therefore shows considerable option value, not an equivalent amount of energized load.
cases.instruction: Describe what the registry establishes and what conversion remains without option-value language.

cases.text: Broad network reach therefore does not establish usable capacity at each campus, especially where private connections remain unobserved.
cases.instruction: Lead with the uneven local connection picture and keep the measurement boundary subordinate.
